r13_policy_audit.governing_question: Can canonical text be derived by a general, deterministic, source-independent normalization that preserves semantic content, locators and exact-span reproducibility?
r13_policy_audit.defect_found: The validator asked a different question. no_private_use_characters and no_control_character_anomalies were flat zero-tolerance counts, so a symbol-font footnote marker and a subset font with no ToUnicode CMap produced the same verdict.
r13_policy_audit.rule_adopted: A Cc/Cs/Co code point -- excepting newline, carriage return, tab and ZWNJ -- is canonicalizable if and only if it is isolated: every neighbour is absent or whitespace. An isolated mark is its own whitespace-delimited token, so deleting it removes a token containing no letters and leaves every other word, page locator and excerpt span untouched. A code point adjacent to any non-space character is treated as semantic corruption, because it may stand for a letter whose identity is unknown and recovering it would require source-specific repair.
r13_policy_audit.losslessness_is_asserted_not_assumed: word_sequence_preserved compares the whitespace-delimited token sequence before and after canonicalization

class_policy.control_Cc_other_than_newline_return_tab: same isolation rule; in practice always fatal, since a control between letters indicates a broken encoding
class_policy.page_and_form_separators: form feed and vertical tab already normalise to a space through normalize_for_match; isolated separators drop
class_policy.zero_width_and_soft_hyphen_and_bom_and_b: already dropped symmetrically on source and excerpt by excerpt_matching.normalize_for_match, so span recovery is unaffected
class_policy.persian_zwnj: explicitly exempt from the anomaly scan; dropped symmetrically at match time
class_policy.unicode_normalization: NFC at fixture preparation only; NFKC is rejected because it would fold Arabic presentation forms and mask the exact defect Gate B exists to catch

validator_gaps_found.issue: R13 has no lexical-plausibility check. It caught the C06 corruption only incidentally, through the U+0003 the broken font uses for a space. Had that font mapped space to U+0020, the corruption would have been invisible: language_sanity scores the shifted text as 100 percent Latin letters, the mojibake markers never fire on pure ASCII, and exact-span matching round-trips its own garbage at 20/20.
validator_gaps_found.recommended_fix: A dictionary hit-rate floor on the extracted text.

c02_private_use_resolution.interpretation: One corresponding-author footnote symbol used four times: twice in the English front matter on page 1 and twice in its Persian mirror on page 3. Both code points sit at the standard symbol-font private-use offset (U+F000 + 0x2A and U+F000 + 0xAF), the signature of a Symbol or Wingdings glyph emitted without a Unicode mapping. None occurs in body text and none is adjacent to a letter.
remaining_blockers: Gate E has no collation record, and there is positive evidence it would fail: of the eleven semantic blocks the pipeline builds, blocks 2-6, 8 and 9 each open with the article's Latin-script numbered footnote apparatus, and blocks 7 and 9 open with the running head '411 | فصلنامه علمی حكمت و فلسفه'. Every block is typed 'other' with an empty heading_path, matching the recorded lost_headings quality warning. Zero ZWNJ survive a 31-page Persian article.
Canonicalization parity: the fixture is the PDF itself, so the drop rule must be applied on the ingestion path or a canonicalized derivative delivered, or R13 certifies text the pipeline never sees.
Licence: license-readiness.json records ready=false for CC BY-NC 4.0 against repository redistribution.
c02_private_use_resolution.bibliography_confirmed: Hekmat va Falsafeh 17(68), 123-153, DOI 10.22054/wph.2021.53089.1867. The PDF masthead 'Vol. 16' survives in block 0 and remains the outlier.

c06_resolution.true_diagnosis: Not a control-character hygiene problem. These are the space, hyphen, period and digit glyphs of a subset font with no ToUnicode CMap whose glyph identifiers sit 0x1D below ASCII. Decoded evidence: '6RFLDO &RQQHFWLRQV' is 'Social Connections'; '(QYLURQPHQWDO 4XDOLW\' is 'Environmental Quality'; '+RXVHKROG QHW DGMXVWHG GLVSRVDEOH LQFRPH SHU SHUVRQ' is 'Household net adjusted disposable income per person'; '$XVWUDOLD', '%HOJLXP', '9RWHU WXUQ-RXW'.
c06_resolution.corrupted_material: Roughly 1,600 characters on page 12 -- the chapter's country-by-indicator well-being dashboard -- extract as gibberish. This is substantive content, exactly the material a Beyond-GDP synthesis case would cite.
c06_resolution.why_not: Zero of the 291 occurrences are isolated. Every one is letter- or digit-adjacent. A repair would have to detect which runs are corrupted -- the same page also contains correct ASCII prose -- and apply a fixed -0x1D shift only to those. That is source-specific run detection plus glyph guessing, which R13 forbids.
c06_resolution.html_fallback_in_raw_tree_is_not_a_fallb: .thesisound/eval-v1-prefreeze/raw/c06-oecd-ch1.html is a 5,813-byte Cloudflare challenge page, not the chapter. No clean OECD component was acquired.

measurement_validity_findings: The pinned mode set biases the selector against the chapter the brief requires. In analysis_profile._block_score, objection weighs 50 and response 55 against definition 80, argument 75 and conclusion 70, and the compensating +35 bonus fires only for critical or debate modes. C09's pinned modes are ['explanatory']. At roughly 71 percent selection the material most likely to be deferred is therefore Chapter VI, the 'major difficulties' the brief explicitly asks the model to trace -- 18,960 tokens, the lowest-weighted substantive chapter.

required_for_global_understanding does not guarantee coverage. Seeding takes only the first eligible block of each required section, capped at 60 percent of target, so a required chapter is represented by one block and the rest must win on rank.

A model regression is not separable from selector behaviour, because the section function and required_for_global_understanding flags that drive _block_score are themselves produced by the model-driven document_mapper. A mapping change moves the selection, which moves the evidence, which moves the episode.
c09_resolution.why_not_option_a: For the profile's own 0.85 target to bind rather than the hard cap the corpus must be at most 77,005 tokens; for achieved coverage to reach 0.85, at most 84,705. The clean corpus is 100,882. Every available cut deletes a named link in the chain the brief specifies: Chapter I is the domestication analogy on which Chapter IV's argument for natural selection is explicitly built, II and III are 'variation and struggle', VI is 'major difficulties' and XIV is the synthesis. Sub-chapter excerpting is exactly what C03 was repaired to avoid. Option A is unavailable without damaging the dependency chain.

option_b_definition.mandatory_configuration_correction: Add 'critical' to C09's pinned modes.
